name: read_disc_counterexample
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
p=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/discs-counterexample.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True); assert p.returncode==0
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','sources/discs-counterexample.txt'],input=p.stdout,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print(p.stdout[:18000])
